_help: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and put your own values there; keys missing from config.json come from this file.
_screen_base: Your laptop's `tailscale serve` address, e.g. https://my-laptop.my-tailnet.ts.net. Empty: no «Экран» picture, Tsuki remembers only until the panel reloads.
_weather: Where the weather (clock, idle screen, Tsuki's remarks) is for. Open-Meteo, no key needed.
_night: Tsuki sleeps on the idle screen between night_from and night_to (24 h, HH:MM).
_idle_after_sec: Seconds without a touch before the idle screen comes up.
